episodes.title: Voir Dire
episodes.summary: Ronald Gladden arrives for jury selection, unaware that an entirely fictional court case has been created just for him.

episodes.title: Opening Arguments
episodes.summary: Ronald and other jurors move into their hotel and adjust to sequestered life.

episodes.title: Foreperson
episodes.summary: The jurors' eccentric behavior presents a challenge for Ronald as their newly-appointed foreperson.

episodes.title: Field Trip
episodes.summary: A suspicious discovery during a surprise field trip to the scene of the incident sheds new light on the case.

episodes.title: Ineffective Assistance
episodes.summary: Things go from bad to worse for the defendant.

episodes.title: Closing Arguments
episodes.summary: The defense is on the ropes after a series of questionable strategic moves and Ken is in a bind after teaching Ronald to play a Korean board game.

episodes.title: Deliberations
episodes.summary: As the foreperson, it's up to Ronald to lead the jury through deliberations and arrive at a unanimous verdict.

episodes.title: The Verdict
episodes.summary: After delivering the verdict, Ronald finds out that another trial was being held in this court and another verdict has been reached.
